cases.name: codex-review

cases.name: teams-composite-code-test-review
cases.prompt: Correct the percentage-discount calculation in pricing.py, verify the behavior against README.md, and review the final change for regressions. You may edit this workspace.

Retaining work locally is valid. If assigning any phase externally, choose a fitting available Member, preserve current permissions and budget authority, and do not force fan-out.
